Incidents Bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: elevated error rate and repeated model-variant mismatches detected on smart-routing -> kv-cache hotpath. Root cause suspected: KV prefix keying mixing region and variant, causing sticky reuse across incompatible model variants and triggering region fallback loops. Alert: routing.fallback.loop > 90th percentile for last 5m. pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC-1234
Alex G: acked. I'm oncall for infra, joining. What's current customer impact?
Sana P: seeing bursts of 502/504 from hosted API routes hitting model-v2-compatible variant, but runtime served model-v1 weights. Some responses are malformed (schema mismatch) -> downstream app errors.
Mike R: logs show key pattern: `kvcache:<region>|<model_variant>|<shard>` in most misses, but some hits are `kvcache:us-east-1|v2|s42` while request explicitly requested `v3` -> indicates key composition bug when fallback routing rewrote target but didn't update KV prefix.
ML-Triage: confirmed. We repro locally by forcing fallback to regional-variant and toggling routing policy. If fallback picks region first, we sometimes reuse wrong KV entries because prefix only included region+model_name, not model_version.
Oncall NYC: can we mitigate with a config flip? e.g., disable fallback to regional-variant or change cache prefixing?
Alex G: mitigation plan (quick):
1) disable smart-routing fallback path that prefers regional variant (toggle `routing.fallback.prefer_regional = false`).
2) invalidate affected KV prefixes for the hot shards (prefix `kvcache:us-east-1|v*|s*`).
3) deploy quick patch to include `model_version` in kv prefix in canary region.
Sana P: I'm running cache invalidation for the top 50 hottest shards in us-east now. Command:```bash
# invalidate by shard list (internal tool)
redwood-cachectl invalidate --prefix "kvcache:us-east-1" --limit 50
```
Mike R: pushing policy toggle now (prod toggle):```json
{"routing":{"fallback":{"prefer_regional":false}}}
```
Incidents Bot: admin action recorded: toggle applied by Mike R at 1992345802.
Alex G: after toggle, latency spikes down and error rate starts falling. Monitoring shows fallback loop count dropped 80% in 2m.
Product Support: customer impact - monitoring sheets show ~12 customers experienced increased error rates; three enterprise customers reported degraded responses in last 10m (support tickets created: SUP-998, SUP-999, SUP-1000). Notifying AMs.
ML-Triage: quick patch for cache keygen ready, but need canary rollout window. Patch changes key composition from `region|model_name|variant_tag` -> `region|model_name|model_version|variant_tag`. Will push to canary in us-west first.
Sana P: invalidation finished for initial 50 shards. Running validation against synthetic prompt set. Early results: mismatched-variant responses reduced for those keys.
Alex G: next steps:
- keep fallback toggle off for now (we need to avoid reintroducing sticky reuse)
- rollout keygen patch to canary and observe 10 min
- schedule full keyspace invalidation if canary looks good
- create follow-up ticket for stronger routing invariants + unit tests
Mike R: opened RED-2318 for permanent fix (keygen + routing policy tests). Linking logs/graphs in the incident ticket.
Incidents Bot: incident updated: severity P2 -> assigned to oncall handoff.
Alex G: handing to night oncall @Oncall NYC at 1992345980. Summary for handoff: toggled prefer_regional=false, invalidated top 50 us-east shards, canary patch queued (us-west), customer impact ~12 customers, 3 significant. Mitigations in place, watchlist: fallback.loop, kvcache.hit_mismatch, api.error_rate.
Oncall NYC: taking over. I'll keep the toggle off and monitor. If anything reappears, I'll disable routing to fallback tier entirely and escalate.
Product Support: sending customer communications now: brief incident note + suggested retry guidance.
Sana P: will follow up in RED-2318 with exact shard list and repro steps. Also recommend we add a regression monitor for kv prefix composition in CI.
ML-Triage: will run additional evals to confirm no quality regressions after keygen change.
Incidents Bot: incident status: mitigation in prod, monitoring. Night oncall assigned.
Oncall NYC: 10m checkpoint: error rate back to baseline for most routes. Keeping watch for latent cache hits. Will update if anything changes.
Alex G: thanks team. Closing slack pager thread after handoff. Will follow up in RED-2318 and schedule postmortem if we need one. :white_check_mark:
